label: Peter D. Klein and John Turri, Infinitism…: Klein and Turri present the strongest origin objection…
locator: §4d, paragraphs beginning “Thus, Aristotle holds” and “The unexplained origin objection”, ending with Dancy quotation
interpretation: Prose reading of an objection reported by Klein and Turri. The original Aristotle, Ginet and Dancy works have not been materialized for these claims; no direct attribution to those authors is created. The transfer-only requirement is a disputed premise, not a theorem about every justification norm.
